categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Touches src/interfaces/wallet.h solely to expose a new wallet method to the GUI, which the IPC rubric explicitly excludes when interface mechanics are not the point.
categories.rationale: Not an IPC PR. The IPC guidelines state that a wallet or GUI PR adding a method to interfaces::Wallet is wallet first and is IPC only if interface mechanics are the point.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Adds rebroadcastwallettx RPC and GUI support via src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/rpc/transactions.cpp.
categories.rationale: Directly solves a common user friction point by allowing manual rebroadcast of wallet transactions from both RPC and the GUI. Currently, users whose transactions drop from mempools must manually extract raw transaction hexes to call sendrawtransaction.
